title: The Fruit That Bites Back
hook: When you eat fresh pineapple, it is digesting you back.
script: When you eat fresh pineapple, it is digesting you back. The culprit is an enzyme called bromelain, which works like tiny scissors. That is why your mouth tingles, and your tongue can feel raw after a big bowl. So why does it not eat your whole mouth? Your cells are replaced so fast that you never notice the damage, and it heals within hours. Heat destroys the enzyme, so canned pineapple never does it. Why would a fruit evolve to bite back? Probably to stop animals from eating it before its seeds are ready to spread.
